subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should an unrecoverable disconnected `openclaw agent` run fail closed by default, or should the CLI preserve the current isolated embedded fallback after a bounded reattach-and-replay attempt?
rationale: Both paths have material user consequences: fail-closed avoids duplicate side effects but can return no result, while fallback preserves result availability but can execute side effects twice.

options.title: Preserve fallback compatibility
options.body: Recover the original run first, then retain the existing isolated embedded fallback as the default when recovery cannot establish a terminal result; make fail-closed explicit.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed default
options.body: Accept that ambiguous Gateway failures may return no result by default in exchange for preventing an automatic second execution, with the new flag as opt-in rerun consent.

options.title: Split by delivery mode
options.body: Use reattach-first and fail-closed behavior for `--deliver` while retaining current fallback behavior for interactive stdout invocations.

recommendation.title: Preserve fallback compatibility
recommendation.body: Recover the original run first, then retain the existing isolated embedded fallback as the default when recovery cannot establish a terminal result; make fail-closed explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged current-main fallback behavior and its session-safety contract originate in this area of work.
